name: P2S · pusher sweep only (no FarmBoard)
description: A FarmLoop pusher on a P2S with no FarmBoard: cool down, sweep, park. Keep the door open (or removed) during prints so parts can leave.
cooldown_fan: M106 P2 S255 ; turn on remote part cooling fan
fans_off: M106 P2 S0 ; turn off remote part cooling fan
M106 P3 S0 ; turn off chamber cooling fan
notes: Uses the FarmLoop app's P2S sweep path, the same path the playbook's door-and-pusher P2S build runs without a bender.
FarmLoop has not published the P2S Stage 1 kit's own G-code. If you have the Stage 1 kit, import one of your FL_S1_ files to use its exact moves, including any bend step.
